`match-83194.json` is the real `https://api.openligadb.de/getmatchdata/83194` response (TSG Hoffenheim 2–3
Hamburger SV, 10 October 2026), recorded once. OpenLigaDB data is under the Open Database License (ODbL).
`match-live-1.json` and `match-live-2.json` are copies edited to `matchIsFinished: false`, with only the first
goal and the first three goals, and without the `After90Minutes` result. `getmatchdata-bl1.json` stands in for a
`/getmatchdata/bl1` matchday: the real match plus two edited copies (other ids, clubs and kick-offs, no goals or
results), one later the same day and one the next day.
